name: cache-timer
description: Prompt cache countdown with compact, keep warm, and an automatic action before it expires

autoCompact.title: Auto-compact
autoCompact.description: Compact on its own before the prompt cache expires, at most once per idle stretch.

autoKeepWarm.title: Auto keep warm
autoKeepWarm.description: Before the cache expires, send one tiny request so it stays warm instead of compacting. Wins over auto-compact when both are on; stops after 3 pings with no message from you.

minutesBeforeExpiry.title: Minutes before expiry
minutesBeforeExpiry.description: How long before the cache expires the auto action runs. 5 acts at 55 minutes on a 1h cache.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives.
